readme.summary: This is the Angular monorepo README, not zone.js documentation — it provides no information about what zone.js is, how it works, or how to use it independently.
readme.top_issue: Wrong README: zone.js is a sub-package of the Angular monorepo but this README covers the Angular framework as a whole, leaving zone.js with zero package-specific documentation (purpose, API, configuration, or usage examples).
